adoption_gate: safe shared development optimum only; no heldout row selection, score-visible adoption, or fallback
baseline_equation: d(nu sigma_r^2)/dr + 2 beta nu sigma_r^2/r = -nu G M_base(<r)/r^2; M_base=M_star,Plummer+M_NFW

baseline_nuisance.stability_gate: optimizer success, finite predictions, and no fitted nuisance parameter at a declared bound

calibration.amplitude_rule: analytic nonnegative macro-chi-square optimum clipped to [0,2]
calibration.development_objective: macro mean chi2-per-bin across four development galaxies
calibration.heldout_policy: freeze eta and a_perp before any Draco/Ursa Minor baseline or candidate score; no heldout tuning or per-row fallback

claim_boundary: A positive heldout result would support generalization of this empirical Jeans response adapter to two untouched galaxies. It would not prove the orthogonal term as physical law, unique Plummer geometry, dark matter mechanism, GR modification, or universal uplift.
controls: half-mass-matched 3D Gaussian passed through the identical nuisance-orthogonal response construction
half-mass-matched 3D top-hat passed through the identical nuisance-orthogonal response construction

development.role: development only; all four were previously inspected
development.source: previously locked Walker et al. 2009 public profiles

fallback_rule: a_perp=0 may be selected only by the development-level safe policy
goal: Test whether a Jeans-equation-specific nuisance-orthogonal response adapter calibrated only on four previously inspected dwarf galaxies improves two untouched public dwarf-galaxy velocity-dispersion profiles.

heldout.source: Spencer et al. 2018 CDS/VizieR J/AJ/156/257 multi-epoch member catalogs, with McConnachie 2012 structural metadata

heldout_preprocessing.profile: global planar velocity-gradient removal; equal-count radial bins; heteroscedastic Gaussian intrinsic-dispersion MLE

operator_object: halo-only 3D NFW density generates the raw response; stellar mass/tracer is not smoothed
primary_metric: heldout safe-Plummer aggregate raw delta chi2 and macro delta chi2-per-bin
prior_result_boundary: Jeans-v1 remains a valid negative artifact and is not overwritten or upgraded by Jeans-v2.
raw_operator: O_perp[rho_NFW]=f(K_d*rho_NFW-rho_NFW), evaluated at full raw response to define delta_sigma_raw
stop_condition: Stop after frozen heldout evaluation, deterministic replay, independent arithmetic/source audit, and exact artifact report. Publish only with the proof label intact.
v2_interpretation: Empirical equation-response adapter orthogonal to the local nuisance tangent of the fitted Jeans baseline. It is not asserted to be a covariant source, density law, or physical proof.
